messages.author: b1bf16cdea722a38
messages.subject: connecting over SSL protocol
parts:
Hi,

I was wondering if it is possible to use sqldf over an SSL connection.

I manage to connect to a remote database with RPostgreSQL by passing the connecting information through the dbname parameter:

con <- dbConnect(drv, dbname="host=my.host.com user=dario dbname=kpi__dario sslcert=/home/dario/postgresql-client.crt sslkey=/home/dario/postgresql-client.key sslrootcert=/home/dario/anr/postgresql-root.crt sslmode=require")

I have tried to pass the same information in sqldf (by passing to the parameter "connection" the value "con" as previously defined) but with no success.
Any clue on how to make it work?

Dario

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: connecting over SSL protocol
parts:
sqldf will use the R options:

sqldf.RPostgreSQL.dbname
sqldf.RPostgreSQL.user
sqldf.RPostgreSQL.password
sqldf.RPostgreSQL.port
sqldf.RPostgreSQL.host

These default to "test", "postgres", "postgres", 5432 and "localhost" but you can set them any way you like:

options(sqldf.RPostgresSQL.dbname="whatever", 
               sqldf.RPostgreSQL.user="whatever", etc.)

?sqldf documents this.

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: connecting over SSL protocol
parts:
Have just added the R option "sqldf.RPostgreSQL.other" to the development source.  Its used like this:

options(sqldf.RPostgreSQL.other = list(a = "abc", b = "def"))

where a, b, etc. are connection parameters with values "abc", "def", etc.  Any number of parameters can be specified.  Its up to the user to ensure that they represent valid parameter names and values.

Either get the package from the development repo at http://sqldf.googlecode.com 
and build and insetall it yourself or else just ovewrite the sqldf function like this:

library(sqldf)  # CRAN version of sqldf
source("http://sqldf.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/R/sqldf.R")
